description: Legacy TikTok pixel track and batch profiles gain captured transport and route-specific envelope advice. Current official SDK v1.3 routes and the published v1.2 track profile are scoped separately from Events API 2.0.

params.name: pixel_code
params.description: It is the Pixel ID from Events Manager. TikTok documents it as required on both the single-event track call and the batch call.
params.fix_hint: Set `pixel_code` to the Pixel ID shown in Events Manager.

params.name: batch
params.description: The batch endpoint posts events under `batch`. The track endpoint posts a single event at the root instead.
Each event is a JSON object, rather than a scalar or list.

params.name: batch[]
params.description: The vendor documents the JSON shape or value type of this field.

params.name: event
params.description: It is the conversion event name. TikTok documents it as required on every track payload.
params.fix_hint: Set `event` to a documented web event name, such as `CompletePayment` or `ViewContent`.

params.name: event_id
params.description: It identifies the event for deduplication against the browser pixel. TikTok documents it as required when the same conversion is sent from both.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `event_id` the Pixel fired, so the pair collapses to one conversion.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: TikTok documents the event time as an ISO 8601 timestamp. An epoch number is not that format, and TikTok then stamps the event with the time it arrived.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2026-07-26T06:00:00Z`.

params.name: context.ip
params.description: It is the visitor's public IP address, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the browser's public IP, not a SHA-256 digest and not your server's address.

params.name: context.user_agent
params.description: It is the visitor's user agent, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the browser's user agent string, not a digest.

params.name: context.ad.callback
params.description: It is the TikTok Click ID (`ttclid`) from the landing URL. TikTok documents it as unhashed on `context.ad.callback`.
params.fix_hint: Copy `ttclid` from the landing URL into `context.ad.callback`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: context.page.url
params.description: It is the page URL when the event happened. TikTok documents it on `context.page`.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `context.page.url`, including the scheme.

params.name: context.page.referrer
params.description: It is the page referrer. TikTok documents it on `context.page`.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute referrer URL, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: context.user.email
params.description: Email must be SHA-256 hashed on the client side before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Trim and lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: context.user.phone_number
params.description: Phone must be SHA-256 hashed on the client side before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Normalize the number, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: context.user.external_id
params.description: Advertiser-side identifiers must be SHA-256 hashed on the client side.
params.fix_hint: Hash the identifier with SHA-256 and send the hex digest.

params.name: context.user.ttp
params.description: It is the first-party `_ttp` cookie. TikTok documents it as unhashed on `context.user.ttp`.
params.fix_hint: Read `_ttp` under your domain into `context.user.ttp`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: properties.currency
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: properties.value
params.description: It is the total value of the order or items, not the unit price.

params.name: properties.contents[].content_id
params.description: It is the product item ID on a contents row. TikTok's Events API SDK documents `content_id` on each `PixelContent` object, not on `properties`.
params.fix_hint: Set `properties.contents[].content_id` to the catalog item ID, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: properties.contents[].content_type
params.description: It is how the row maps to the catalog. TikTok's Events API SDK documents `product` or `product_group` on each contents object.
params.fix_hint: Set `properties.contents[].content_type` to `product` or `product_group`. Do not put `content_type` on `properties`.

params.name: properties.contents[].quantity
params.description: It is the item count on a contents row. TikTok's Events API SDK documents `quantity` as a number.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.contents[].quantity` as a number, such as `2`.

params.name: properties.contents[].price
params.description: It is the unit price of one item. TikTok's Events API SDK documents `price` as the single-item price, not the order total.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.contents[].price` as a number, such as `10`. Put the order total in `properties.value`.

params.name: properties.contents[].content_name
params.description: It is the name of the page or product on a contents row. TikTok's Events API SDK documents `content_name` on each `PixelContent` object.
params.fix_hint: Set `properties.contents[].content_name` to the page or product name, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: properties.contents[].content_category
params.description: It is the category of the page or product on a contents row. TikTok's Events API SDK documents `content_category` on each `PixelContent` object.
params.fix_hint: Set `properties.contents[].content_category` to the category, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: properties.contents[].status
params.description: It is the status of an order, item, or service on a contents row. TikTok's Events API SDK documents `status` as a string with no enumerated values.
params.fix_hint: Set `properties.contents[].status` to the order or item status, or drop the empty pair.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. TikTok requires customer email to be SHA-256 hashed on the client side.
rules.fix_hint: Trim the address, lowercase it, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but TikTok documents `context.ip`, `context.user_agent`, `context.ad.callback`, and `context.user.ttp` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address, user agent, click ID, or `_ttp` cookie. Hashing it makes the event unmatchable.

rules.message: The event has no user identifier. TikTok documents hashed email, phone, external_id, the `_ttp` cookie, click ID, or IP as the match keys that attach the conversion to a person.
rules.fix_hint: Send hashed `context.user.email`, `phone_number`, or `external_id`, or unhashed `context.user.ttp`, `context.ad.callback`, or `context.ip`.

rules.message: A `CompletePayment` or `PlaceAnOrder` event is missing `properties.value` or `properties.currency`. TikTok documents both on those revenue events.
rules.fix_hint: Set `properties.value` to the order total and `properties.currency` to a three-letter ISO 4217 code.

params.name: method
params.description: The pinned official EventCallback sender uses POST. Other methods receive producer-profile advice rather than a universal receiver rejection claim.

params.name: content_type
params.description: The pinned sender selects application/json; MIME parameters are normalized by the capture layer.

params.name: headers.access-token
params.description: The actual SDK writes its required access_token parameter into Access-Token. The generated No authorization required section describes Swagger auth settings, not the absence of this custom token header.

params.name: body_encoding
params.description: The producer normally sends a JSON entity. Its optional body argument can emit no body, so absence is advice. Opaque encodings remain unverified.

params.name: path
params.description: Captured normalized path supplies the track-versus-batch discriminator.

params.name: body
params.description: Parsed capture body supplies scope only; existing body contracts retain native type errors.

params.name: body.batch
params.description: The batch model requires a batch member. Advice applies only to captured batch-route objects; existing array type and length checks retain ownership of supplied values.

params.name: body.event
params.description: The single-track model requires the root event member. A batch object does not establish a valid single-track envelope.
